title: Bechet's Brooklyn house and school of music
summary: Bechet's Quincy Street house, his sign, Laura and the Great Dane Butch.

blocks.x: Yeah, in the spring of 46. Yeah, in the spring of 46. And he, he had this old ramshackle house in Brooklyn on Quincy Street. Yeah, I never did get over there.
I knew about it though. Yeah.

I never seen it. And, uh, uh, he had a sign up front that he made that said Sidney Bichet School of Music. Yeah, I don't remember that. And it was, I know, I like, I think he liked the house and bought it because it, it had these old French New Orleans style windows in it.
By the way, was he living with an Indian girl? Seems like I heard it that time.
Yeah, an Indian girl named Laura. Laura, yeah. From Canada, yeah. Yeah. And he had a beautiful big Great Dane puppy named Butch. Never saw that.
